name: trial-e2
description: Add-on calibration for E2 (run once per machine, after the machine's first trial and before its first E2 main run): a probe pass of every E2 and E2c arm of all 30 algorithms and operations (first call + 5 calls per arm, unbatched). It derives only the batch sizes of the new arms, with the first trial's rule (ceil(100 x effective timer resolution / probe median) below 100x the resolution); every other threshold of the machine stays unchanged. Canary every 5 minutes.
